notes.title: V0.1.1 Patch Notes · Save File Recovery Guide
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

First and foremost, I want to extend my sincerest apologies. Due to my personal error during this update, some of you have experienced lost save files, causing significant inconvenience and frustration. I feel deeply ashamed and have reflected on my carelessness. Please accept my heartfelt apology, and thank you for your understanding and patience.


V0.1.1 Patch Notes · Save File Recovery Guide
What’s New
[olist]
Reduced Test Mode Duration

Based on extensive feedback that the test mode was too long, we’ve cut the duration in half. After five minutes, you can choose to settle and enter Roguelike mode, or continue the full test.

Updated Taskbar Icon

Updated Game Folder Path (The cause of everything)
[/olist]

Save File Recovery Instructions
Because of my mistake when updating the game folder path, some old save files didn’t migrate correctly and were lost. I’m truly sorry for the trouble! If you find your progress missing, please follow these steps to recover your save:
[olist]
Open File Explorer and navigate to:
[code]C:\\Users\\YOURNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\MBTactics\\InsideCreaturesOut\\save.json[/code]
Locate and copy the save.json file.

Paste the copied save.json into:
[code]C:\\Users\\YOURNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\MBTactics\\16CP-Survivors\\save.json[/code]
Restart the game and check if your save has been restored.
[/olist]
If this method doesn’t recover your save, please contact us:

Official Discord: discord.gg/pG8jxEZrfu

Support Email: contact@mbtactics.com

We’ll investigate promptly and provide one-on-one technical support.



Once again, I deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by my mistake. We will strengthen our update testing and review processes to prevent similar issues in the future. Thank you for your understanding, support, and for joining us on the adventure of 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors!

Happy gaming and best wishes on your journey,


— The MBTactics Development Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Art Updates:

Updated the artwork shown at the end of Questionnaire Mode.


Updates and Bug Fixes:

Removed an unintended Debug UI that was visible.
Fixed an issue where the volume slider couldn’t be dragged with the mouse when set to 0.
Added a Chinese-English language toggle button to the Settings screen.
Fixed incorrect icon links in the Out-of-Combat Growth screen.
Fixed some missing characters in the localization.


Flow Improvements:

Exiting Test Mode now directly unlocks Roguelike Mode.
